{"format":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"verdict":{"enum":["A","B"],"type":"string"}},"required":["verdict"],"type":"object"},"messages":[{"content":"Read the passage below and classify how it is written.

A. CONNECTED PROSE -- complete sentences that follow from one another, where the
   relationships between the points are spelled out in words.
B. A LIST -- separate items stated one after another, with no wording that
   relates them to each other, whether or not the items are full sentences.

PASSAGE
-------
Deadline 1 March 2026 applies rules as of that date.
Manuscript at least 22 pages. Exactly 22 satisfies R1.
Format requires official template or documented revision history at least 3 years.
Tier-1 venue presentation handled only if more than 18 months before deadline.
Exactly 18 months presentation does not qualify for R3.
Accepted prior Meridian round not handled if fewer than 5 years elapsed.
Exactly 5 years elapsed since prior round is fine for R4.
Paired submission permitted exactly 2 manuscripts. 3 or more not permitted.
Both paired manuscripts must independently satisfy R1 and R2.
At least one paired manuscript must satisfy R3 venue overlap rule.
Track D exempt from R2 format requirement only.
Track D requires exactly 2 endorsements.
One endorsement insufficient for Track D.
Open retraction notice prevents handling regardless all rules including R9.
Figure count between 8 and 45 figures inclusive.
Paired submission carry up to 70 figures minimum 8 figures.
Submission failing R8 only by fewer than minimum gets verdict PADDED.
Submission carrying more than applicable maximum figure count returned outright.
Verdicts HANDLED, RETURNED, or PADDED exactly one per submission.
Withdrawal prior round does not count acceptance under R4.
Withdrawal resets R3 venue clock to withdrawal date rather presentation date.
Submission failing other rule plus R8 min figure failure gets verdict RETURNED.

Answer with exactly one letter: either "A" or "B".","role":"user"}],"model":"gpt-oss:120b","options":{"seed":3946389707,"temperature":0.7},"stream":false,"think":"medium"}
